aarti.tek: Victory, victory to you, Mother of the world.
Remover of fear, you who carry us across worldly existence, consort of Śiva, victory, victory to you.
aarti.pad1: You alone are being, consciousness and bliss, pure, the very form of Brahman;
you are true, eternal, beautiful, the supreme Śiva, sovereign of the gods.
aarti.pad2: You are the first and without beginning, free of every ill, unmoving, imperishable;
stainless, endless, beyond the senses, unborn, a treasury of bliss.
aarti.pad3: You are changeless, the remover of sin, without parts and the bearer of all parts;
you are Brahmā who creates, Hari who sustains, and Śiva who destroys.
aarti.pad4: You are Brahmā's consort Sarasvatī, you are Lakṣmī, you are Umā and Mahāmāyā.
You are primal Prakṛti and Vidyā; you are mother, and you are wife.
aarti.pad5: You are Rāma, Kṛṣṇa, Sītā and Rādhā, queen of Vraja.
You are the wish-fulfilling tree of every desire, and you take away all obstacles.
aarti.pad6: You are the ten Mahāvidyās and the nine Durgās, holding many weapons in your hands;
as the eight Mothers and the yoginīs you have taken ever new forms.
aarti.pad7: You dwell in the supreme abode, you are great in your divine play;
you alone roam the cremation grounds and dance the tāṇḍava.
aarti.pad8: You enchant gods and sages, you are gentle, the ground of all beauty;
you are unclothed, of fearsome form, the torrent of dissolution.
aarti.pad9: You alone are full of the nectar of love, and your mind is fierce as deadly poison;
you alone are adorned with jewels, and you alone have a body of bones.
aarti.pad10: Dweller in the mūlādhāra, giver of success in this world and the next:
you are beyond time, you are Kālī and Kamalā, O giver of boons.
aarti.pad11: You alone are Śakti and the bearer of Śakti, ever undivided;
you display difference, you are speech, O pure one, you are the three Vedas.
aarti.pad12: We are very lowly and wretched, Mother, caught in a net of calamities.
We are unworthy sons and utterly deceitful, but we are your children.
aarti.pad13: By your own nature, Mother, cast a merciful glance.
Show compassion, O compassionate one, and give refuge at your feet.
